identity.title: ELR-1000: A Community-Generated Dataset for Endangered Indic Indigenous Languages
identity.paper_title: ELR-1000: A Community-Generated Dataset for Endangered Indic Indigenous Languages
identity.paper_venue_as_declared_by_dataset_card: Proceedings of the 14th International Joint Conference on Natural Language Processing and the 4th Asia-Pacific Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (IJCNLP-AACL 2025)

exact_locators.supported_metadata: The card describes 1,073 recipes, 10 languages, 11,213 images and 42 hours of audio across text, image and audio modalities.
Mundari is explicitly one of the ten listed languages.
The dataset card states community participation, higher-than-living-wage compensation and explicit consent for contributions to be shared.
The card declares KPL BY-NC-SA-FS 1.0 and describes noncommercial attribution/share-alike/software conditions.

deduplication.reason: No ELR-1000 identity was found in the current standalone MMSC discoveries artifact or named source-census verification artifacts inspected for this run. A permanent source ID is withheld until the complete 87-lead reconciliation namespace is deterministically updated rather than creating a parallel identity opportunistically.

scope_classification.current_promotable_level: dataset-card metadata and governance evidence only

promotion_decision.reason: Public dataset-card metadata is sufficiently exact-located to document corpus identity, declared scope, declared consent and declared license. Underlying recipe, audio, image and participant-derived cultural content remains gated pending item-level access, provenance, cultural-access and redistribution review.
